# pictoggle

> Zero-dependency image checkbox for the web. Any PNG/SVG/WebP/GIF becomes a toggle — full colour when checked, grayscale when not. Ships as a form-associated `<pic-toggle>` custom element that behaves like a native `<input type="checkbox">`, and as a `createPicToggle()` factory for plain JavaScript.

- Package name on npm: `pictoggle`
- Repository: https://github.com/Insider515/pictoggle
- Live demo: https://insider515.github.io/pictoggle/
- Install: `npm install pictoggle`
- Runtime dependencies: none
- Build step: none (single ES module file)
- Minimum Node for development/testing: 18

- [README](README.md): full usage guide — install, HTML/JS quick start, form integration, HTML attributes, JavaScript API, events, styling, framework integration (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte), browser support

## Public API surface

### Web Component `<pic-toggle>`

HTML attributes: `src`, `alt`, `label`, `label-position` (left|right|top|bottom|none), `size`, `checked`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `value`, `form`.

JavaScript properties (mirror `HTMLInputElement`): `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `value`, `type`, `form`, `labels`, `validity`, `validationMessage`, `willValidate`, `imageError`.

Methods: `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`, `setCustomValidity(message)`.

Events: `change`, `input`, `image-error`.

### Programmatic factory `createPicToggle(options)`

Options: `src`, `alt`, `checked`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`, `size`, `label`, `labelPosition`, `attributes`, `onChange`, `onIndeterminate`, `onError`, `ownerDocument`.

Returned element methods: `getChecked()`, `getIndeterminate()`, `getImageError()`, `setChecked(value, opts?)`, `setIndeterminate(value, opts?)`, `toggle()`, `setDisabled(value)`, `setSize(value)`, `setLabel(text)`, `setLabelPosition(pos)`, `setSrc(url)`, `setAlt(text)`, `setOnChange(cb)`, `setOnError(cb)`, `setOnIndeterminate(cb)`, `destroy()`.

### CSS custom properties

`--pt-size`, `--pt-gap`, `--pt-radius`, `--pt-active-opacity`, `--pt-inactive-opacity`, `--pt-hover-opacity`, `--pt-active-filter`, `--pt-inactive-filter`, `--pt-indeterminate-filter`, `--pt-indeterminate-opacity`, `--pt-focus-ring`, `--pt-focus-ring-offset`, `--pt-transition`.

## Browser support

- `createPicToggle()` factory: Chrome 60, Firefox 55, Safari 11.1, Edge 79.
- `<pic-toggle>` visuals and a11y: Chrome 67, Firefox 63, Safari 10.1, Edge 79.
- `<pic-toggle>` form association via `ElementInternals`: Chrome 77, Firefox 93, Safari 16.4, Edge 79. Older Safari falls back to a hidden `<input>`.

## Semantics (do not mistake for native)

- HTML attribute `checked` records the INITIAL value (`defaultChecked`), matching native `<input type="checkbox">`. Programmatic `.checked = x` does NOT rewrite the attribute. For state-dependent CSS use `pic-toggle[aria-checked="true"]`, not `pic-toggle[checked]`.
- `change` event fires only on an actual state transition (no-op assignments do not fire).
- `Enter` does NOT toggle (native checkbox parity); `Space` does.
- Programmatic `.defaultChecked = x` also updates `.checked` (no dirty flag is tracked).
